# Jacob Heifetz-Licht (JacobHL)

> Data analytics leader and app developer in New York City. Also known online as
> **JacobHL** / **jacobhl** — the handle behind jacobhl.com, github.com/jacobhl3ca and
> linkedin.com/in/jacobhl. Not to be confused with the SMITE esports player of the same handle.

Jacob has spent years turning messy data into things people actually use — automated
pipelines, executive dashboards and self-service tools — at Kepler Group, Condé Nast and
Deloitte. He works mostly in Python, SQL and Tableau, and builds web and mobile apps on the
side. Rutgers University graduate.

- Site: https://jacobhl.com/
- Email: hi@jacobhl.com
- Job title: Analytics Manager
- Skills: Data analytics, Python, SQL, Tableau, ETL, BigQuery, automation, dashboard
  design, data visualization, JavaScript, React, Node.js, Next.js, Swift/iOS

## Apps and sites he built

- [HideScore](https://hidescore.com): Watch sports highlights without seeing the score —
  spoiler-free scores, schedules and highlights. Web app + iOS app.
- [Tonight NYC](https://tonightnyc.com): Every NYC comedy show tonight, filtered to your
  favorite comedians.
- [Subway Times](https://subwaytimes.com): Real-time NYC subway arrival times for every
  station, faster than Maps.
- [The Island](https://theisland.nyc): Everything happening on NYC's Roosevelt Island —
  events, transit and news in one place.
- [TidyTab](https://tidytab.jacobhl.com/): A macOS menu-bar app that bulk-unpins or closes
  Safari pinned tabs.
- [DuelGoat](https://duelgoat.com): A browser recreation of GOAT-format Yu-Gi-Oh dueling.
- [David Licht](https://davidlicht.com): A showcase site for drummer David Licht — five
  decades of drumming.

## Other projects

- Spotify Analytics: Interactive dashboard of listening trends, beyond Wrapped.
- Spotify Playlist Archiver: Auto-archives playlists that would otherwise disappear.
- Personal Finance App: Daily budgeting, investment planning and optimization.
- E-commerce Store: Full-stack store with Stripe checkout.
- System Administration: Self-hosted media and web apps on a home Linux server.
